With the grace of Allah Almighty, it has touched the peak of success in a very short span of time. The department has the honour to award Master degree in the discipline of Sociology. Research activities for Master`s Students are made compulsory. Likewise, field work in the M.A Sociology is compulsory in those areas of the Province, which are sociologically significant.
Development, which deals with the updated participatory approaches followed by field work at various non-governmental organizations, and other relevant agencies working for multi-dimensional development of the community.
